technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure, but weak momentum confirmation, negative volume signals, and price below key moving averages create low-probability entry despite potential bounce setup.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 36 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (3+ years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (392.0), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures energy multinationals, with earnings event in 36 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme oversold (below 30) with supertrend bullish and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment creates textbook mean-reversion setup near support at 32.55, offering asymmetric risk/reward for contrarian traders in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), zero momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, OBV flat, CMF negative), price below all key moving averages, no institutional conviction, and earnings binary event in 36 days make this a low-probability entry despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI 9 extreme oversold with supertrend bullish and EMA 50/200 alignment creates textbook mean-reversion setup. However, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD) combined with zero momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, OBV flat, CMF negative) and earnings binary event in 36 days make conviction too low for entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (392.0) and flat yield curve signal imminent recession risk; earnings event in 36 days creates binary downside exposure with no institutional conviction to support bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case despite technical oversold setup
decision.portfolio_note: Already 8 positions open in Energy sector; adding EQT would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro crisis without offsetting conviction.
